description: Activate (active=true) or deactivate (active=false) a single referrer by refer_id. Activation moves inactive→pending; deactivation moves active→turning_inactive (the async worker finalizes the state). If the referrer is already in an intermediate state (pending|deleting|turning_inactive) the API returns 400 ({ errCode, errMsg }: 'Operation in progress, ...'). Works for both library- and folder-level referrers.

active.description: true to activate, false to deactivate

library_id.description: Library UUID. Resolved from GET /library when omitted.

name: panda_set_refer_status
title: Activate/Deactivate Domain Referrer
